reply.emotion: warm and friendly, feeling a quiet spark of happiness
notes: Sonreír is an irregular verb that follows the same stem-changing pattern as reír, adding an accent mark to the í in many forms (sonrío, sonríe).

senses.definition: Hacer un gesto con los labios que muestra alegría o agrado, sin llegar a reírse con sonido.

examples.text: Ella empezó a sonreír cuando vio a su amigo.
examples.translation: She started to smile when she saw her friend.
examples.emotion: tender and pleased, seeing someone dear after a long time
